about_short_description.short_description: Jeel Pay is a fintech company developing payment and collection solutions for educational institutions.

product.name: Tuition Fee Installment Service
product.description: A service allowing students and families to pay educational fees in up to 12 monthly installments without interest or late fees.

product.name: Institution Payment Collection Platform
product.description: A platform for educational institutions to track and manage student installment payment requests and receive tuition payments in advance from Jeel Pay.

product.name: Sharia Compliance Advisory
product.description: An independent Shariah committee ensures that Jeel Pay's financial services comply with Islamic Sharia principles through ongoing review and guidance.
